items.text: The Eagles will play their first game on Sunday without Jalen Hurts.
Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday vs CAR along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley.
items.implication: PHI RB room thins to Dameon Pierce as primary; pass-catchers elevated with McKee
items.opportunity: Dameon Pierce goal-line/early-down work; DeVonta Smith/Goedert/Wicks targets

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (with AD Mitchell).
Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury.

Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (expect Metcalf + Bernard 2-WR). PHI McKee with 4th-string RB but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; fade thin PIT WRs beyond Metcalf; start PHI pass-catchers with McKee
items.opportunity: Metcalf target share spike; PHI WR/TE volume

items.text: Ladd McConkey (and Quentin Johnston) listed IN.
items.implication: Full LAC WR corps available vs KC

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams.
Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Washington defense buffet for pass-catchers.
Loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup.
items.why: Seattle pass D problem + QB issues
